text:
alex: Heads up — proposing a change to SIEM export retention + access controls. TL;DR: 90d for app/debug logs, 365d for security/audit logs. Introduce JIT unmasking via KMS proxy, and a scoped role 'siem_exporter' for authorized analysts. Need feedback/objections before EOD.

mona: Can you spell out the migration/backfill plan and rollback steps?

alex: Plan: create new secured export buckets with CMK 'siem-prod-rotation', run a backfill job to copy the last 365d of security/audit logs into the secured bucket, revoke old public-access configs, deprecate old buckets after a 30d overlap. Rollback = copy back, re-enable access. Will need SRE + vendor coordination.

devon: FYI vendors currently pull from the old bucket via signed URLs. We need a transition window + allowlist update. Suggest 2-week overlap and an announcement.

pete_sre: We can support a 2-week overlap. Backfill est: ~2TB, ~ $50 egress (very rough). I'll open an ops runbook and a cost ticket.

mona: RBAC question: who gets 'siem_exporter'? Should be team-scoped. We should avoid org-wide grants for multitenant exports.

alex: Agreed — proposal is scoped roles like `siem_exporter:{team}` or `siem_exporter:read-only` with required ticket justification stored in JIRA. Raw/unmasked access requires JIT approval via security-bot.

security-bot: Reminder — policy requires CMK usage justification and an approver in the ticket. See https://internal/redwood/security/siem-export-policy for details.

jenna: On vuln triage: sometimes we need raw traces older than 90d for long-running investigations. Can we add a legal/IR carveout to request extended retention per-case?

alex: Yes — propose carveout workflow: create an incident JIRA with a special tag, security approves, we set a temporary TTL on the secured bucket and log the approval. All actions audited.

devon: Can we automate TTL changes? Idea: infra endpoint `POST /siem/leases {bucket, ttl, approver_ticket}` that updates lifecycle rules after approval.

pete_sre: We can build that. For now keep it manual (security approval + ops runbook). If it looks stable, automate after a quarter.

mona: Two quick operational asks: 1) KMS rotation schedule — org CMK vs per-tenant? 2) How do we handle partner access audit trails?

alex: KMS approach: Phase 1 = org CMK + envelope encryption per-bucket. Phase 2 = per-tenant CMKs once we have key provisioning automation. Partner access: signed URLs limited to allowlist, all fetches logged into audit stream (forwarded to KMS-protected ledger).

alex: Ticket template (put in JIRA):
```
Title: SIEM Export Lease Request - [INC-#]
Owner: <team>
Reason: <root cause + justification>
Bucket: s3://siem-exports/<path>
TTL: <30d|90d|365d>
Approver: <security>
CMK: siem-prod-rotation
Partners impacted: <list>
```

pet e_sre: :thumbsup: I'll draft the runbook, the migration checklist, and a cost estimate. Ping me when you have a target migration week.

alex: Thanks all. Please react with :eyes: if you think you should be on the approval list, or DM me with objections. I'll consolidate comments and post a final proposal by 17:00 PT.

mona: :eyes:

devon: :eyes: I'll notify partner contacts and schedule the overlap window.

jenna: Adding a follow-up — we should add a retention exceptions board review every month for any active extended leases.

alex: Good call. We'll include that in the runbook.

security-bot: Note: Any extended leases must be accompanied by a signed justification, TTL, and a recycle/cleanup ticket.

alex: Closing note — if no major objections, I'll start the JIRA and tag SRE + Legal + Compliance.
